prompt:
You are a formal verification assistant. The following Dafny program fails Dafny verification.

=== PROGRAM ===
predicate sorted_seg(a:array<int>, i:int, j:int) //j not included
requires 0 <= i <= j <= a.Length
reads a
{
    forall l, k :: i <= l <= k < j ==> a[l] <= a[k]
}


method selSort (a:array<int>, c:int, f:int)//f excluded
modifies a 
requires 0 <= c <= f <= a.Length //when c==f empty sequence
ensures sorted_seg(a,c,f) 
ensures multiset(a[c..f]) == old(multiset(a[c..f]))
ensures a[..c]==old(a[..c]) && a[f..]==old(a[f..])
 {if (c<=f-1){//two elements at least
  var i:=c;
  while (i<f-1) //outer loop
     decreases f-i
    invariant c<=i<= (f) + 1
    invariant sorted_seg(a,c,i)
    invariant forall k,l::c<=k<i && i<=l<f ==> a[k]<=a[l]
    invariant multiset(a[c..f]) == old(multiset(a[c..f]))
    invariant a[..c]==old(a[..c]) && a[f..]==old(a[f..])
  {
   var less:=i;
   var j:=i+1;
   while (j<f) //inner loop
    decreases f-j//write
    invariant i+1<=j<=f//write
    invariant i<=less<f
    invariant sorted_seg(a,c,i)
    invariant forall k::i<=k<j ==> a[less] <= a[k]
    invariant forall k,l::c<=k<i && i<=l<f ==> a[k]<=a[l]
    invariant multiset(a[c..f]) == old(multiset(a[c..f]))
    invariant a[..c]==old(a[..c]) && a[f..]==old(a[f..])

    { if (a[j]<a[less]) {less:=j;}
      j:=j+1;
    }
   a[i],a[less]:=a[less],a[i];
   i:=i+1;
  }
 }
 }

=== DAFNY ERROR ===
program.dfy(20,24): Error: function precondition could not be proved

program.dfy(2,21): Related location: this proposition could not be proved
  |
2 | requires 0 <= i <= j <= a.Length
  |                      ^^

Dafny program verifier finished with 2 verified, 1 error

=== COUNTEREXAMPLE ===
At initial state: a.Length = 2440, c = 2438, f = 2440. At a program state: i = 2438.

Analyze the failure and respond with ONLY a valid JSON object — no explanation, no markdown, no code fences. Use exactly this structure:

{
  "spec_element": "<one of: requires | invariant | ensures>",
  "proof_obligation": "<one of: initiation | preservation | bridge>",
  "diagnosis": "<explanation of what broke and why>",
  "repair": "<the corrected Dafny specification line that restores the intended behavior>"
}

Definitions:
- requires: the precondition that must hold before the method executes
- invariant: the loop invariant that must hold throughout the loop
- ensures: the postcondition that the method must guarantee on return
- initiation: the precondition does not establish the invariant at loop entry
- preservation: the loop body does not maintain the invariant
- bridge: the invariant and loop exit condition do not imply the postcondition
